snippet.title: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum! | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now "Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum"

Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum! is a relaxing puzzle and restoration game where you carefully rebuild shattered history.

🔍 Features:
• Find and assemble 3,105 scattered artifact pieces.
• Restore 428 unique historical objects.
• Tidy up and explore beautiful, detailed museum halls.
• Enjoy a relaxing, cozy, and satisfying gameplay experience.

Follow us for updates:

#Museologist #IndieGame #CozyGames #PuzzleGame #RestorationGame #インディーゲーム #癒しゲーム
